speech.heard: In Trinidad and Tobago, the entire workforce is part-time. In Poland, it is 0.4%. This counts everyone working less than 35 actual weekly hours. Ukraine has 100%. Belarus has 92.8%. India has 24.8% and Brazil has 24.8%. Germany has 44.5%, which is 15 times the 3% in the UAE. Poland is the world's lowest at 0.4%, Mongolia has 4.8% and Russia has 7.1%. How many hours does your work week last?
